statistics_frozen_pre_data.mad_convention_verbatim: median_x = median(x); MAD(x) = median( abs(x_i - median_x) )  -- RAW MAD, NO 1.4826 factor
statistics_frozen_pre_data.within_variant_verbatim: within_v = median( MAD(P1 variant v), MAD(P2 variant v) )  where MAD is taken over per-seed replica medians within each platform
statistics_frozen_pre_data.ratio_rule_verbatim: if within_v > 0: ratio_v = abs(shift_v) / within_v; if within_v == 0 and abs(shift_v) == 0: ratio_v = 0; if within_v == 0 and abs(shift_v) > 0: ratio_v = +INF
statistics_frozen_pre_data.shift_definition: shift_v = median_i( d_i ), d_i = median(P2, seed_i) - median(P1, seed_i); computed ONLY when both platforms have data for the same seed

bootstrap_implementation.procedure: on each bootstrap iteration: draw N indices with replacement from [0..N-1]; take the corresponding paired differences d_i; statistic = median(resampled differences)
bootstrap_implementation.percentile_ci_verbatim: sort bootstrap statistics; q(p): h = (B - 1) * p; lo = floor(h); hi = ceil(h); linear interpolation; CI95 = q(0.025), q(0.975)

statistics_frozen_pre_data.verdict_rule: PLATFORM_SENSITIVE: CI excludes 0 AND ratio_v >= 1; PLATFORM_INSENSITIVE: CI contains 0 OR ratio_v < 0.5; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE (per variant); WO-level: both variants SENSITIVE -> PLATFORM_SENSITIVE, both INSENSITIVE -> PLATFORM_INSENSITIVE, else INCONCLUSIVE
statistics_frozen_pre_data.p1_only_boundary: after the P1 leg ONLY per-seed results and descriptive distribution of P1 are produced; shift_v, paired bootstrap CI, ratio_v and any platform verdict are FORBIDDEN until P2 data for the same seeds exist
